# CreditsPlan (International)

> International AI Coding subscription plan price comparison: 13 verified brands and 57 plans with prices, quotas and representative models — each manually verified against the vendor's official pricing page, with full price-change history. CN site (CNY plans): https://creditsplan.cn/.

## Key pages

- [Plan comparison home](https://www.creditsplan.com/): full price comparison table across brands and plans
- [Verified brands](https://www.creditsplan.com/brands/)
- [Head-to-head comparisons](https://www.creditsplan.com/compare/): compare any two brands on price and quota
- [Cheapest plans](https://www.creditsplan.com/rankings/cheapest/): ranked by monthly price
- [Plan advisor](https://www.creditsplan.com/advisor/): value ranking by model family / usage / budget
- [Price change timeline](https://www.creditsplan.com/price-changes/): every verified price change
- [Monthly price reports](https://www.creditsplan.com/reports/)
- [Methodology](https://www.creditsplan.com/methodology.html)
